Detaching or interrupting observation changes no job state; a cancellation request or acknowledgement is not terminal cancellation, which requires authoritative confirmation that the job's effects have stopped. For parent cancellation, stop admitting or dispatching new child work and request cancellation of active children; keep the parent pending or UNKNOWN until authoritative evidence resolves each child's effect outcome. Any partial result is explicitly labeled and bounded to its evidenced scope, never represented as full success. Keep the outcome UNKNOWN until exact authorized reconciliation resolves it, and reconcile under the same job identity before any new attempt is allowed.
